---
title: "The Salted Gate"
chapter: 1
---

The kettle began to whistle on the iron stove. Elena ignored it and unbolted the door.

"You're late," Marcus said, stepping past her onto the braided rug. His coat was damp with evening rain.

"I had to wait for the night watch to clear the harbor." Elena felt afraid, though she kept her voice level. "They searched three trawlers at sunset."

Marcus sat down at the wooden table and unrolled a map of the lower bay. "Let them search. The tide turns in forty minutes. We only need the skiff."

"Forty minutes isn't enough time to reach the seawall."

"It's enough if we take the narrow channel through the pilings."
